_meta.title: Ezekiel — key verses (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Curated key verses from Ezekiel (the shepherd who seeks the lost, a new heart and a new spirit, breath into the dry bones). Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 26 Ezekiel); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: key verses from the book's restoration high points; judgment/vision oracles largely omitted
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: getbible's KJV renders the divine name as 'the Lord'; text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
verses.plain: I will seek the lost and bring back the strays. I will bind up the injured and strengthen the weak.

verses.text: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
verses.plain: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you; I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.

verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:
verses.plain: This is what the Sovereign Lord says to these bones: I will make breath enter you, and you will come to life.
